name: Chin-Up (Machine Assisted)
instructions: Set the counterweight. More weight on the pin means more help, so log what is on the stack rather than what you lifted: the number should go down as you get stronger.
Kneel or stand on the pad and take the handles with an underhand, shoulder-width grip.
Pull until your chin clears your hands, keeping your chest up and your elbows driving down.
Lower all the way to straight arms under control.
